user.title: Sign in to HappyParking
user.description:
**Step 1.** [Open the HappyParking Kakao login]({auth_url}) and sign in as usual.

**Step 2.** You are sent back to the HappyParking site. Copy the whole address out of your browser's address bar and paste it below.

That address carries your login, and Home Assistant reads your parking server, user id and site code straight out of it.

If the page moves on before you can copy the address, paste your login token instead — in the browser, developer tools → Application → Local Storage → `token`.

data.login_result: Address you were sent back to
